answer: Weight here rides a tit-for-tat relay ledger. Each epoch an identity serves seed-derived transcript shards to assigned peers, who return signed receipts; self-issued ones are void since provider and requester differ. Weight is bytes served over bytes requested, and three epochs under 0.9 zero its influence until it repays. Honest nodes hold a ratio near one, an oasis peers return to; a thousand clones fetch mostly from each other, so outside demand dries up, and egress runs 5 TB an epoch, $425 at $0.085 a gigabyte. A farm is an island of mirrors, all reflection, no outside reader.
